narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Nine is odd, so I cannot halve it, and nine fifteenths is in lowest terms now.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Look again. Nine is three threes, and fifteen is five threes.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Three is still a common factor of both, so the fraction is not finished yet.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Small steps or one big step, both roads end at the same fraction in lowest terms.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Write forty four sixty sixths in lowest terms, first in steps, then in one go.
